 FC Seoul clinched its seventh league title.
 FC Seoul played Gangwon FC in the Hana Bank K League 1 2026 Round 33 at Seoul World Cup Stadium on the 24th and drew 1-1. Seoul moved to 67 points (20 wins, 7 draws, 6 losses), completely fending off Ulsan's chase. At the same time, second-place Ulsan drew 2-2 with Pohang Steelers, confirming FC Seoul's title regardless of the remaining matches.
 In the second half, Gangwon FC's Hwang Mun-gi is pulling FC Seoul's Andersson's jersey during his break. 2026.10.24
